name: bangumi-analyzer
description: Bangumi 个人动画数据同步与分析工具（本地优先，长期个人数据库）

scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "pnpm -C packages/shared run dev" "pnpm -C packages/server run dev" "pnpm -C packages/web run dev"
scripts.dev:server: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -C packages/server run dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -C packages/server run build && pnpm -C packages/web run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -C packages/shared run typecheck && pnpm -C packages/server run typecheck && pnpm -C packages/web run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -C packages/shared run test && pnpm -C packages/server run test && pnpm -C packages/web run test
